articles.title: Instagram head Adam Mosseri explains what makes iPhone Duo ‘a bit of a tricky form factor’ for Instagram
articles.summary: Instagram head Adam Mosseri has admitted that getting the app right on Apple’s iPhone Duo is harder than it looks.
articles.body: Instagram head Adam Mosseri has admitted that getting the app right on Apple’s iPhone Duo is harder than it looks. Replying to users on Threads, Mosseri said it will be “pretty challenging” to make Instagram feel great on the foldable, calling it “a bit of a tricky form factor”. The remarks stand out because Instagram is one of the apps Apple itself has tagged as “Made for iPhone Duo”.In a separate post, Mosseri pointed to a specific clash. When the Duo is closed, Apple places navigation buttons along the right-hand edge of the screen. That is exactly where Instagram keeps the like, comment and share buttons on Reels, so two sets of controls end up competing for the same strip of display.iPhone Duo’s side-mounted controls are forcing apps like Instagram to rethink their layoutThe Duo is Apple’s first foldable, and its interface shifts many controls to the right edge instead of the bottom. Apps built for tall 20:9 screens don’t always adapt neatly. On the unfolded display, early users found Instagram sitting in the middle with empty space on either side. Rotating the phone pushed controls back to the bottom, the back button jumped to the top-left corner, and Stories didn’t fill the screen.Instagram’s iPhone Duo update puts Reels and comments side by sideInstagram has now rolled out a dedicated iPhone Duo version of its app. With the phone open, the main feed stretches into a wider layout, and Reels play at full size with comments alongside, so the video keeps running while you read. Control buttons now sit in a sidebar. Messages and notifications open in two columns, with the inbox on one side and the chat on the other.The wider app catalogue is moving quickly too. Apple’s marketing chief Greg Joswiak said on November 16 that more than 200,000 apps are now optimised for the iPhone Duo, double the 100,000 figure Apple shared earlier this month. The count covers apps built with the iOS 27.1 SDK or later that fill both displays and use vertical controls in the status bar.Instagram’s update, though, mostly reworks the unfolded screen. On the closed phone, Stories and Reels keep their familiar vertical format, and that is where Mosseri spotted the button clash in the first place.Your child uses AI every day. articles.title: Eisha Singh unfollows Avinash Mishra on social media; sparks fallout rumours after recent ‘I love you’ exchange in viral video
articles.summary: Television actors Eisha Singh and Avinash Mishra have sparked rumours of a possible fallout after the actress reportedly unfollowed him on Instagram.
articles.body: Television actors Eisha Singh and Avinash Mishra have sparked rumours of a possible fallout after the actress reportedly unfollowed him on Instagram. The two became close friends inside the Bigg Boss house and often spoke about their close bond. They were recently seen on the TV show Pati Patni Aur Panga 2 as well. However, rumours suggest that they have now parted ways.According to reports, Eisha no longer follows Avinash on Instagram, although the actor reportedly continues to follow her. Moreover, Eisha’s mother, Rekha Singh, recently shared a cryptic note on her Instagram Story. While nether of the two have shared an official confirmation on the same, fans are speculating that they are no longer friends.The speculation comes shortly after the two were seen sharing a rather affectionate moment at Avinash’s Khatron Ke Khiladi 15 success party. During the celebration, Avinash expressed his gratitude towards Eisha, saying he felt fortunate to have her in his life. When Eisha asked him to continue, he went on to say, “I love you, baby.” Eisha responded with an “I love you too”, and the exchange quickly caught the attention of fans online.A user on X wrote, "So finally it's officially over. Eisha has unfollowed Avi. It really breaks my heart that they both r not together anymoreWishing nothing but only good for both of them in their life Thnk u for all the beautiful memories in these 2 years." Another user said, "I feel terrible for Avisha shippers. How can you emotionally invest in a couple with a clear cheating history. Shipping should be done where love exists and not lust or whatever sham."One user also wrote, "Eisha also said: jab Tak ring nhi aati tab Tak koi official nhi hota to allegations to sahi lagati ab eisha se jyada fame usse uper dikhne lag tha eisha ka fame Kam pad gya tha Avinash ke same to Avinash pe ye sab allegations lagane hi the n ladki ko aur uske maa ko this is game."Eisha and Avinash first became close during their stint on Bigg Boss 18.
